title: Simon's gear - Simon Phillips (official site)
notes: His current Tama kits (STAR Maple, STAR Walnut, Monarch, Mirage, Starclassic): two 24" bass drums, a 20" gong drum, a row of rack toms from 10" to 16", three snares, a low-pitch set of octobans, two Iron Cobra double pedals.

title: About Simon - Simon Phillips (official site)
notes: Timeline: first recording at six with the Sid Phillips band (BBC Aeolian Hall); joined the band at twelve (1969-73), BBC broadcasts; Jesus Christ Superstar in the West End (1973-74); London sessions and Chopyn (1975-77); Jack Bruce, Jeff Beck, Stanley Clarke, Al Di Meola (1977-83); Crises his first production (1983); the Who's 1989 tour; Los Angeles and Toto from 1992. Tony Williams's Believe It (1975) a favourite; introduced to Williams by Jack Bruce in 1977.

title: List of musicians who play left-handed - Wikipedia
notes: Lists Simon Phillips (Toto) as right-handed but playing open-handed.

title: The Michael Schenker Group (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Personnel: Simon Phillips drums, Mo Foster bass, Don Airey keyboards as session musicians; produced by Roger Glover. Cozy Powell drums on the 1980 live tracks of the 2009 reissue.

title: Moonlight Shadow - Wikipedia
notes: The first tracks recorded together in early February 1983 at Oldfield's studio in Denham: acoustic guitar (Oldfield), bass (Spalding), drums (Phillips), electric guitar (Tim Renwick). Pierre Moerlen mimes Phillips's part in the video.
